author: Krono II
title: Hypothesis: Late Time Feature Injection
abstract: This experiment tests a fundamental change to input processing. Instead of feeding the time feature through the CNN, I will inject it into the network after the pooling layer. The hypothesis is that this prevents the non-spatial time information from being distorted by convolutions and allows the final MLP to use it more effectively.
